limitations.note: The combinational decode fixed the one-cycle delay, but it dropped the explicit reset guard and allowed unknown state bits to produce unknown outputs instead of defaulting both outputs to zero.
The test always drove a falling reset edge and waited before checking, so it did not cover startup with reset already low and the state register still unknown.
